passages.text: For the choirmaster. Of David the servant of the LORD, who sang this song to the LORD on the day the LORD had delivered him from the hand of all his enemies and from the hand of Saul. He said: I love You, O LORD, my strength.
passages.sermon:
David was a servant of the LORD.
David sang a song to the LORD.
David sang this song on the day the LORD delivered him.
The LORD saved David from all his enemies.
The LORD saved David from the hand of Saul.
David spoke to the LORD.
David said, "I love You, O LORD."
David called the LORD his strength.
passages.original: לַמְנַצֵּ֤חַ׀ לְעֶ֥בֶד יְהוָ֗ה לְדָ֫וִ֥ד אֲשֶׁ֤ר דִּבֶּ֨ר׀ לַיהוָ֗ה אֶת־ דִּ֭בְרֵי הַשִּׁירָ֣ה הַזֹּ֑את בְּי֤וֹם הִֽצִּיל־ יְהוָ֘ה אוֹת֥וֹ מִכַּ֥ף כָּל־ אֹ֝יְבָ֗יו וּמִיַּ֥ד שָׁאֽוּל׃ וַיֹּאמַ֡ר אֶרְחָמְךָ֖ יְהוָ֣ה חִזְקִֽי׃

passages.text: The LORD is my rock, my fortress, and my deliverer. My God is my rock, in whom I take refuge, my shield, and the horn of my salvation, my stronghold.
passages.sermon:
David is the servant of the LORD.
David speaks to the LORD.
The LORD is my rock.
The LORD is my fortress.
The LORD is my deliverer.
The LORD is my God.
My God is my rock.
I take refuge in Him.
The LORD is my shield.
The LORD is the horn of my salvation.
The LORD is my stronghold.
passages.original: יְהוָ֤ה׀ סַֽלְעִ֥י וּמְצוּדָתִ֗י וּמְפַ֫לְטִ֥י אֵלִ֣י צ֭וּרִי אֶֽחֱסֶה־ בּ֑וֹ מָֽגִנִּ֥י וְקֶֽרֶן־ יִ֝שְׁעִ֗י מִשְׂגַּבִּֽי׃

passages.text: I will call upon the LORD, who is worthy to be praised; so shall I be saved from my enemies.
passages.sermon:
David is the servant of the LORD.
David sang this song to the LORD.
David spoke on the day the LORD saved him from all his enemies and from Saul.
David said:
The LORD is worthy of praise.
I will call upon the LORD.
The LORD will save me from my enemies.
passages.original: מְ֭הֻלָּל אֶקְרָ֣א יְהוָ֑ה וּמִן־ אֹ֝יְבַ֗י אִוָּשֵֽׁעַ׃

passages.text: The cords of death encompassed me; the torrents of chaos overwhelmed me.
passages.sermon: Death surrounded me like cords.\r\nEvil overwhelmed me like rushing torrents.
passages.original: אֲפָפ֥וּנִי חֶבְלֵי־ מָ֑וֶת וְֽנַחֲלֵ֖י בְלִיַּ֣עַל יְבַֽעֲתֽוּנִי׃

passages.text: The cords of Sheol entangled me; the snares of death confronted me.
passages.sermon:
Sheol is the place of the dead.
The cords of Sheol wrapped around me.
The snares of death stood before me.
The snares of death blocked my way.
passages.original: חֶבְלֵ֣י שְׁא֣וֹל סְבָב֑וּנִי קִ֝דְּמ֗וּנִי מ֣וֹקְשֵׁי מָֽוֶת׃

passages.text: In my distress I called upon the LORD; I cried to my God for help. From His temple He heard my voice, and my cry for His help reached His ears.
passages.sermon:
I felt distress.
I called upon the LORD.
I cried to my God for help.
God heard my voice from His temple.
My cry for help reached His ears.
passages.original: בַּצַּר־ לִ֤י׀ אֶֽקְרָ֣א יְהוָה֮ וְאֶל־ אֱלֹהַ֪י אֲשַׁ֫וֵּ֥עַ יִשְׁמַ֣ע מֵהֵיכָל֣וֹ קוֹלִ֑י וְ֝שַׁוְעָתִ֗י לְפָנָ֤יו׀ תָּב֬וֹא בְאָזְנָֽיו׃

passages.text: Then the earth shook and quaked, and the foundations of the mountains trembled; they were shaken because He burned with anger.
passages.sermon:
God became very angry.
The earth shook.
The earth quaked.
The foundations of the mountains trembled.
The mountains shook.
God’s anger caused this shaking.
passages.original: וַתִּגְעַ֬שׁ וַתִּרְעַ֨שׁ׀ הָאָ֗רֶץ וּמוֹסְדֵ֣י הָרִ֣ים יִרְגָּ֑זוּ וַ֝יִּתְגָּֽעֲשׁ֗וּ כִּי־ חָ֥רָה לֽוֹ׃

passages.text: Smoke rose from His nostrils, and consuming fire came from His mouth; glowing coals blazed forth.
passages.sermon:
God is powerful and holy.
Smoke rose from His nostrils.
Fire came from His mouth.
The fire consumed everything in its path.
Glowing coals blazed out from Him.
passages.original: עָ֘לָ֤ה עָשָׁ֨ן׀ בְּאַפּ֗וֹ וְאֵשׁ־ מִפִּ֥יו תֹּאכֵ֑ל גֶּ֝חָלִ֗ים בָּעֲר֥וּ מִמֶּֽנּוּ׃

passages.text: He parted the heavens and came down with dark clouds beneath His feet.
passages.sermon:
God acted with great power.
God parted the heavens.
God came down to the earth.
Dark clouds lay beneath God’s feet.
passages.original: וַיֵּ֣ט שָׁ֭מַיִם וַיֵּרַ֑ד וַ֝עֲרָפֶ֗ל תַּ֣חַת רַגְלָֽיו׃

passages.text: He mounted a cherub and flew; He soared on the wings of the wind.
passages.sermon:
God is powerful and glorious.
God mounted a cherub.
God flew.
God soared on the wings of the wind.
passages.original: וַיִּרְכַּ֣ב עַל־ כְּ֭רוּב וַיָּעֹ֑ף וַ֝יֵּ֗דֶא עַל־ כַּנְפֵי־ רֽוּחַ׃

passages.text: He made darkness His hiding place, and storm clouds a canopy around Him.
passages.sermon:
God made darkness His hiding place.
He surrounded Himself with darkness.
He used storm clouds as His shelter.
Thick clouds full of water formed a canopy around Him.
passages.original: יָ֤שֶׁת חֹ֨שֶׁךְ׀ סִתְר֗וֹ סְבִֽיבוֹתָ֥יו סֻכָּת֑וֹ חֶשְׁכַת־ מַ֝֗יִם עָבֵ֥י שְׁחָקִֽים׃

passages.text: From the brightness of His presence His clouds advanced— hailstones and coals of fire.
passages.sermon:
God is present.
His presence shines with great brightness.
Clouds move forward from this brightness.
Hailstones come with these clouds.
Coals of fire also come with these clouds.
passages.original: מִנֹּ֗גַהּ נֶ֫גְדּ֥וֹ עָבָ֥יו עָבְר֑וּ בָּ֝רָ֗ד וְגַֽחֲלֵי־ אֵֽשׁ׃

passages.text: The LORD thundered from heaven; the voice of the Most High resounded— hailstones and coals of fire.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is the Most High God.
The LORD thundered in the sky.
The Most High made His voice heard.
Hailstones fell.
Coals of fire came down.
passages.original: וַיַּרְעֵ֬ם בַּשָּׁמַ֨יִם׀ יְֽהוָ֗ה וְ֭עֶלְיוֹן יִתֵּ֣ן קֹל֑וֹ בָּ֝רָ֗ד וְגַֽחֲלֵי־ אֵֽשׁ׃

passages.text: He shot His arrows and scattered the foes; He hurled lightning and routed them.
passages.sermon:
God acted with great power.
God shot His arrows.
His arrows scattered His enemies.
God hurled many bolts of lightning.
His lightning confused and defeated His enemies.
passages.original: וַיִּשְׁלַ֣ח חִ֭צָּיו וַיְפִיצֵ֑ם וּבְרָקִ֥ים רָ֝ב וַיְהֻמֵּֽם׃

passages.text: The channels of the sea appeared, and the foundations of the world were exposed, at Your rebuke, O LORD, at the blast of the breath of Your nostrils.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is powerful.
The LORD rebuked the earth.
The channels of the sea became visible.
The foundations of the world were uncovered.
This happened because the LORD spoke in anger.
This happened at the blast of the breath from the LORD’s nostrils.
passages.original: וַיֵּ֤רָא֨וּ׀ אֲפִ֥יקֵי מַ֗יִם וַֽיִּגָּלוּ֮ מוֹסְד֪וֹת תֵּ֫בֵ֥ל מִגַּעֲרָ֣תְךָ֣ יְהוָ֑ה מִ֝נִּשְׁמַ֗ת ר֣וּחַ אַפֶּֽךָ׃

passages.text: He reached down from on high and took hold of me; He drew me out of deep waters.
passages.sermon:
God is powerful and cares for me.
God is above all things.
God reached down from His high place.
God took hold of me.
God pulled me out of deep waters.
God saved me from danger.
passages.original: יִשְׁלַ֣ח מִ֭מָּרוֹם יִקָּחֵ֑נִי יַֽ֝מְשֵׁ֗נִי מִמַּ֥יִם רַבִּֽים׃

passages.text: He rescued me from my powerful enemy, from foes too mighty for me.
passages.sermon:
The LORD rescued me.
He saved me from my powerful enemy.
He delivered me from those who hated me.
My enemies were too strong for me.
My foes were mightier than I was.
The LORD acted to save me from them.
passages.original: יַצִּילֵ֗נִי מֵאֹיְבִ֥י עָ֑ז וּ֝מִשֹּׂנְאַ֗י כִּֽי־ אָמְצ֥וּ מִמֶּֽנִּי׃

passages.text: They confronted me in my day of calamity, but the LORD was my support.
passages.sermon:
My enemies confronted me.
They came against me on my day of calamity.
The LORD supported me.
The LORD became my refuge.
passages.original: יְקַדְּמ֥וּנִי בְיוֹם־ אֵידִ֑י וַֽיְהִי־ יְהוָ֖ה לְמִשְׁעָ֣ן לִֽי׃

passages.text: He brought me out into the open; He rescued me because He delighted in me.
passages.sermon: The LORD brought me out into a wide place.\r\nHe rescued me.\r\nHe did this because He delighted in me.
passages.original: וַיּוֹצִיאֵ֥נִי לַמֶּרְחָ֑ב יְ֝חַלְּצֵ֗נִי כִּ֘י חָ֥פֵֽץ בִּֽי׃

passages.text: The LORD has rewarded me according to my righteousness; He has repaid me according to the cleanness of my hands.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is just and holy.
The LORD has rewarded me.
He rewarded me because I acted righteously.
He repaid me because my hands were clean.
He gave me what was right because I did what was right.
passages.original: יִגְמְלֵ֣נִי יְהוָ֣ה כְּצִדְקִ֑י כְּבֹ֥ר יָ֝דַ֗י יָשִׁ֥יב לִֽי׃

passages.text: For I have kept the ways of the LORD and have not wickedly departed from my God.
passages.sermon: I have kept the ways of the LORD.\r\nI have not turned away from my God.\r\nI have not acted wickedly against Him.
passages.original: כִּֽי־ שָׁ֭מַרְתִּי דַּרְכֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וְלֹֽא־ רָ֝שַׁ֗עְתִּי מֵאֱלֹהָֽי׃

passages.text: For all His ordinances are before me; I have not disregarded His statutes.
passages.sermon:
God gave His ordinances.
I keep all His ordinances before me.
God gave His statutes.
I do not disregard His statutes.
passages.original: כִּ֣י כָל־ מִשְׁפָּטָ֣יו לְנֶגְדִּ֑י וְ֝חֻקֹּתָ֗יו לֹא־ אָסִ֥יר מֶֽנִּי׃

passages.text: And I have been blameless before Him and kept myself from iniquity.
passages.sermon: I have been blameless before God.\r\nI have kept myself from sin.
passages.original: וָאֱהִ֣י תָמִ֣ים עִמּ֑וֹ וָ֝אֶשְׁתַּמֵּ֗ר מֵעֲוֺנִֽי׃

passages.text: So the LORD has repaid me according to my righteousness, according to the cleanness of my hands in His sight.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is just and holy.
The LORD sees everything I do.
The LORD has repaid me.
He has repaid me because I acted righteously.
He has repaid me because my hands are clean before Him.
He judges me by what He sees.
passages.original: וַיָּֽשֶׁב־ יְהוָ֣ה לִ֣י כְצִדְקִ֑י כְּבֹ֥ר יָ֝דַ֗י לְנֶ֣גֶד עֵינָֽיו׃

passages.text: To the faithful You show Yourself faithful, to the blameless You show Yourself blameless; to the pure You show Yourself pure, but to the crooked You show Yourself shrewd.
passages.sermon:
God responds to people according to their character.
God shows Himself faithful to faithful people.
God shows Himself blameless to blameless people.
God shows Himself pure to pure people.
God shows Himself shrewd to crooked people.
passages.original: עִם־ חָסִ֥יד תִּתְחַסָּ֑ד עִם־ גְּבַ֥ר תָּ֝מִ֗ים תִּתַּמָּֽם׃ עִם־ נָבָ֥ר תִּתְבָּרָ֑ר וְעִם־ עִ֝קֵּ֗שׁ תִּתְפַּתָּֽל׃

passages.text: For You save an afflicted people, but You humble those with haughty eyes.
passages.sermon:
God saves people who suffer.
God helps the afflicted.
God brings down the proud.
God humbles those with arrogant eyes.
passages.original: כִּֽי־ אַ֭תָּה עַם־ עָנִ֣י תוֹשִׁ֑יעַ וְעֵינַ֖יִם רָמ֣וֹת תַּשְׁפִּֽיל׃

passages.text: For You, O LORD, light my lamp; my God lights up my darkness.
passages.sermon: The LORD is God.\r\nThe LORD lights my lamp.\r\nMy God makes my darkness bright.
passages.original: כִּֽי־ אַ֭תָּה תָּאִ֣יר נֵרִ֑י יְהוָ֥ה אֱ֝לֹהַ֗י יַגִּ֥יהַּ חָשְׁכִּֽי׃

passages.text: For in You I can charge an army, and with my God I can scale a wall.
passages.sermon:
David speaks to God.
David trusts God.
David says, “With You, I can charge against an army.”
David says, “With my God, I can leap over a wall.”
passages.original: כִּֽי־ בְ֭ךָ אָרֻ֣ץ גְּד֑וּד וּ֝בֵֽאלֹהַ֗י אֲדַלֶּג־ שֽׁוּר׃

passages.text: As for God, His way is perfect; the word of the LORD is flawless. He is a shield to all who take refuge in Him.
passages.sermon:
God is perfect.
God’s way is perfect.
The LORD’s word is flawless.
God protects people who trust Him.
God is a shield for everyone who takes refuge in Him.
passages.original: הָאֵל֮ תָּמִ֪ים דַּ֫רְכּ֥וֹ אִמְרַֽת־ יְהוָ֥ה צְרוּפָ֑ה מָגֵ֥ן ה֝֗וּא לְכֹ֤ל׀ הַחֹסִ֬ים בּֽוֹ׃

passages.text: For who is God besides the LORD? And who is the Rock except our God?
passages.sermon:
The LORD is God.
No one else is God.
Our God is the Rock.
No one else is the Rock.
passages.original: כִּ֤י מִ֣י אֱ֭לוֹהַּ מִבַּלְעֲדֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וּמִ֥י צ֝֗וּר זוּלָתִ֥י אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ׃

passages.text: It is God who arms me with strength and makes my way clear.
passages.sermon:
God gives me strength.
God makes my path clear.
God acts with power.
God guides me without error.
passages.original: הָ֭אֵל הַמְאַזְּרֵ֣נִי חָ֑יִל וַיִּתֵּ֖ן תָּמִ֣ים דַּרְכִּֽי׃

passages.text: He makes my feet like those of a deer and stations me upon the heights.
passages.sermon: God acts with power and care.\r\nGod makes my feet swift and sure, like a deer.\r\nGod places me securely on high places.
passages.original: מְשַׁוֶּ֣ה רַ֭גְלַי כָּאַיָּל֑וֹת וְעַ֥ל בָּ֝מֹתַ֗י יַעֲמִידֵֽנִי׃

passages.text: He trains my hands for battle; my arms can bend a bow of bronze.
passages.sermon:
God trains my hands for battle.
God gives me skill to fight.
My arms become strong.
My arms can bend a bow made of bronze.
passages.original: מְלַמֵּ֣ד יָ֭דַי לַמִּלְחָמָ֑ה וְֽנִחֲתָ֥ה קֶֽשֶׁת־ נְ֝חוּשָׁ֗ה זְרוֹעֹתָֽי׃

passages.text: You have given me Your shield of salvation; Your right hand upholds me, and Your gentleness exalts me.
passages.sermon: God gives me His shield of salvation.\r\nGod’s right hand supports me.\r\nGod’s gentleness lifts me up.
passages.original: וַתִּתֶּן־ לִי֮ מָגֵ֪ן יִ֫שְׁעֶ֥ךָ וִֽימִינְךָ֥ תִסְעָדֵ֑נִי וְֽעַנְוַתְךָ֥ תַרְבֵּֽנִי׃

passages.text: You broaden the path beneath me so that my ankles do not give way.
passages.sermon:
God protects me.
God makes my path wide.
God places a strong path under my feet.
My steps are steady.
My ankles do not slip.
God keeps me from falling.
passages.original: תַּרְחִ֣יב צַעֲדִ֣י תַחְתָּ֑י וְלֹ֥א מָ֝עֲד֗וּ קַרְסֻלָּֽי׃

passages.text: I pursued my enemies and overtook them; I did not turn back until they were consumed.
passages.sermon:
David is the speaker.
David is a servant of God.
David had enemies.
David chased his enemies.
David caught his enemies.
David did not stop.
David did not turn back.
David kept going until his enemies were destroyed.
passages.original: אֶרְדּ֣וֹף א֭וֹיְבַי וְאַשִּׂיגֵ֑ם וְלֹֽא־ אָ֝שׁוּב עַד־ כַּלּוֹתָֽם׃

passages.text: I crushed them so they could not rise; they have fallen under my feet.
passages.sermon: I crushed my enemies.\r\nThey could not rise again.\r\nThey fell under my feet.
passages.original: אֶ֭מְחָצֵם וְלֹא־ יֻ֣כְלוּ ק֑וּם יִ֝פְּל֗וּ תַּ֣חַת רַגְלָֽי׃

passages.text: You have armed me with strength for battle; You have subdued my foes beneath me.
passages.sermon:
God gave me strength for battle.
God made me strong.
God caused my enemies to fall under me.
God subdued those who fought against me.
passages.original: וַתְּאַזְּרֵ֣נִי חַ֭יִל לַמִּלְחָמָ֑ה תַּכְרִ֖יעַ קָמַ֣י תַּחְתָּֽי׃

passages.text: You have made my enemies retreat before me; I put an end to those who hated me.
passages.sermon:
God gave me victory over my enemies.
My enemies turned their backs and fled from me.
I destroyed those who hated me.
I ended the power of those who opposed me.
passages.original: וְֽאֹיְבַ֗י נָתַ֣תָּה לִּ֣י עֹ֑רֶף וּ֝מְשַׂנְאַ֗י אַצְמִיתֵֽם׃

passages.text: They cried for help, but there was no one to save them— to the LORD, but He did not answer.
passages.sermon:
My enemies cried for help.
No one saved them.
They called to the LORD.
The LORD did not answer them.
passages.original: יְשַׁוְּע֥וּ וְאֵין־ מוֹשִׁ֑יעַ עַל־ יְ֝הוָ֗ה וְלֹ֣א עָנָֽם׃

passages.text: I ground them as dust in the face of the wind; I trampled them like mud in the streets.
passages.sermon:
David speaks about his enemies.
David says, "I crushed my enemies."
I made them like dust.
The wind blew the dust away.
I trampled my enemies.
I made them like mud in the streets.
passages.original: וְֽאֶשְׁחָקֵ֗ם כְּעָפָ֥ר עַל־ פְּנֵי־ ר֑וּחַ כְּטִ֖יט חוּצ֣וֹת אֲרִיקֵֽם׃

passages.text: You have delivered me from the strife of the people; You have made me the head of nations; a people I had not known shall serve me.
passages.sermon: The LORD delivered me from the strife of the people.\r\nThe LORD made me the head of nations.\r\nPeople I did not know now serve me.
passages.original: תְּפַלְּטֵנִי֮ מֵרִ֪יבֵ֫י עָ֥ם תְּ֭שִׂימֵנִי לְרֹ֣אשׁ גּוֹיִ֑ם עַ֖ם לֹא־ יָדַ֣עְתִּי יַֽעַבְדֽוּנִי׃

passages.text: When they hear me, they obey me; foreigners cower before me.
passages.sermon: Foreigners hear me.\r\nForeigners obey me.\r\nForeigners cower before me.
passages.original: לְשֵׁ֣מַֽע אֹ֭זֶן יִשָּׁ֣מְעוּ לִ֑י בְּנֵֽי־ נֵ֝כָ֗ר יְכַחֲשׁוּ־ לִֽי׃

passages.text: Foreigners lose heart and come trembling from their strongholds.
passages.sermon:
Foreigners feel afraid.
They lose their courage.
They come out from their strong places.
They tremble as they come.
passages.original: בְּנֵי־ נֵכָ֥ר יִבֹּ֑לוּ וְ֝יַחְרְג֗וּ מִֽמִּסְגְּרֽוֹתֵיהֶֽם׃

passages.text: The LORD lives, and blessed be my Rock! And may the God of my salvation be exalted— the God who avenges me and subdues nations beneath me, who delivers me from my enemies. You exalt me above my foes; You rescue me from violent men.
passages.sermon:
The LORD lives.
The LORD is my Rock.
The LORD is blessed.
The God of my salvation is exalted.
God gives me vengeance.
God subdues nations under me.
God delivers me from my enemies.
God lifts me above those who rise against me.
God rescues me from violent men.
passages.original: חַי־ יְ֭הוָה וּבָר֣וּךְ צוּרִ֑י וְ֝יָר֗וּם אֱלוֹהֵ֥י יִשְׁעִֽי׃ הָאֵ֗ל הַנּוֹתֵ֣ן נְקָמ֣וֹת לִ֑י וַיַּדְבֵּ֖ר עַמִּ֣ים תַּחְתָּֽי׃ מְפַלְּטִ֗י מֵאֹ֫יְבָ֥י אַ֣ף מִן־ קָ֭מַי תְּרוֹמְמֵ֑נִי מֵאִ֥ישׁ חָ֝מָ֗ס תַּצִּילֵֽנִי׃

passages.text: Therefore I will praise You, O LORD, among the nations; I will sing praises to Your name.
passages.sermon:
David wrote this psalm.
David was king of Israel.
David spoke to the LORD.
The LORD is God.
The LORD saved David.
David said, “I will praise You, LORD.”
David said, “I will praise You among the nations.”
David said, “I will sing praises to Your name.”
passages.original: עַל־ כֵּ֤ן׀ אוֹדְךָ֖ בַגּוֹיִ֥ם׀ יְהוָ֑ה וּלְשִׁמְךָ֥ אֲזַמֵּֽרָה׃

passages.text: Great salvation He brings to His king. He shows loving devotion to His anointed, to David and his descendants forever.
passages.sermon:
God brings great salvation to His king.
God shows loving devotion to His anointed one.
God shows loving devotion to David.
God shows loving devotion to David’s descendants forever.
passages.original: מַגְדִּל יְשׁוּע֪וֹת מַ֫לְכּ֥וֹ וְעֹ֤שֶׂה חֶ֨סֶד׀ לִמְשִׁיח֗וֹ לְדָוִ֥ד וּלְזַרְע֗וֹ עַד־ עוֹלָֽם׃
